bg.$description: color used by the toast component for its flat raised surface (issue #353: surface-raised, the deprecated alias of surface.s1, so the step itself).

bg-image.$description: image used by the toast component over its background color: none by default; a theme may paint a gradient here (document 2, rule 6).

backdrop-filter.$description: filter used by the toast component behind its surface, taken whole: none by default; a theme may blur here (document 2, rule 6; issue #342).

fg.$description: color used by the toast component for the heading ink (issue #353).

message-fg.$description: color used by the toast component for the message ink (issue #353).

dismiss-fg.$description: Foreground of the toast dismiss glyph.

border.$description: color used by the toast component for its hairline edge (issue #353).

border-width.$description: dimension used by the toast component for its hairline edge.

shadow.$description: shadow used by the toast component for its elevation (issue #353: e4). The only theme-controlled shadow in the toast's box-shadow (document 2, rule 6).

radius.$description: dimension used by the toast component for its corners (issue #353: 16px).

padding.$description: dimension used by the toast component for its padding (issue #353: 12px).

gap.$description: dimension used by the toast component between icon, text, action and dismiss button (issue #353: 12px).

width.$description: dimension used by the toast component for the widest a toast gets (issue #353: 22.5rem).

font-family.$description: Font family for the toast heading (document 2, rule 6; issue #347). Override it to give toasts their own heading typeface.

icon-size.$description: dimension used by the toast component for the tone icon.

icon.$description: color used by the toast component for the neutral tone icon: the tone lives in the icon alone (issue #353).
color used by the toast component for the info tone icon: the tone lives in the icon alone (issue #353).
color used by the toast component for the success tone icon: the tone lives in the icon alone (issue #353).
color used by the toast component for the warning tone icon: the tone lives in the icon alone (issue #353).
color used by the toast component for the danger tone icon: the tone lives in the icon alone (issue #353).
